The wrist of the assisting arm is placed where it crosses the center line
The space between the outer wrist and torso should be about one hand blade apart
Be careful not to let your blocking hand move outside the line connecting your leg and body
The assisting armpit should not detach from your body, making the elbow rise up

name.en: Inner Forearm Outward Block + Assisted Low Pressing Block

tips.text: Strike the forearm moving upward with a four fingered gathered left palm
When taking the second half step, lower the right elbow again and perform Araemakgi
Strike the right forearm with the left palm, and clench the fist
Both fists must not start Jireugi from the waist

name.en: Jumping 360 Spinning Target Kick + Diamond Side Punch

tips.text: Start with Oreun Jageun Doljjeogwi, block your face, then connect with Jireugi
Shift your weight on your right foot for airborne Pyojeokchagi, and jump in the air by kicking the ground
The left foot will set on the ground while the body is spinning mid-air
Kick the palm of your left hand, the target, with your right foot blade before setting your foot
Your left foot must not touch the ground before kicking the target

name.en: Spread Single Mountain Low Pressing Block

tips.text: The wrist of the arm performing Anpalmok Ulgul Bakkanmakgi should be level with the philtrum
The arm performing Araemakgi should be about two raised fists apart from your adjacent leg

name.en: Flat Hand Single Mountain Low Pressing Block

tips.text: The wrist of the arm performing Anpalmok Ulgul Bakkanmakgi should be level with the philtrum
The arm performing Araemakgi should be about two raised fists apart from your adjacent leg
Push the palm of your hand forward to lower abdomen elevation on the same side as the front foot
Push the palm hand forward to philtrum elevation on the same side as the hind foot
Both hands must form a straight line with the center line
Be careful not to let your shoulders rise
Bend the elbows at torso elevation, place them in front of the solar plexus
Bring the palm of your hands close to your body
For Oen Dwitgubi, Jajeunbal is a technique where you move while your center is placed on your left leg
Maintain the Dwitgubi posture by pulling your left foot the moment your right foot pushes and sets forward about a half step
Do not set your foot forward after pulling your hind leg
This move must also be performed smoothly in motion like Hwidulleomakgi

name.en: Hammer Fist Double Side Body Strike

tips.text: Attach the armpit firmly to the body to concentrate force
The fists should be placed slightly over the elbow
Be careful not to let the fists rise excessively

name.en: Stepping Back Outward Single Mountain Block

tips.text: The wrist of the arm performing Anpalmok Ulgul Bakkanmakgi should be level with the philtrum
The arm performing Araemakgi should be about two raised fists apart from your adjacent leg
The elbow of the arm that performed Khaljaebi should lightly touch the back of the assisting hand
Straighten the wrist so it doesn't bend
The left elbow should touch the top of the back of the right hand
Your two fists start at the back
When thrusting, keep your arms in, touching the torso
Place your elbows close to your torso
Jeocheojireugi should be performed by thrusting upward (about one fist length above the elbow) slightly from below
The elbow should not move away from the body too much
Your fists must not open outward
Be careful not to let your fists rise above the elbow level or thrust downward
Only move the arm blocking the lower body
The hand blade and center line should be aligned
Be careful not to let the elbow of the arm blocking the face rise first
Be careful not to change elevation
Lightly touch the arch of the back of the foot blade inside the supporting leg
Naturally straighten the ankle of the leg inside the knee of the supporting leg
The knee should face forward and the ankle should straighten naturally
Both hands should be placed naturally inside the body to avoid inconvenience when kicking
Place the four fingers from the index finger together
Place the wrist of the thrusting arm at shoulder level, and the supporting arm at the solar plexus level
Perform the Sonal Anchigi move by pulling both elbows towards your body
The wrist of the striking hand should be straight
Your hand blade should be raised near your neck level

name.en: Foot Blade Back Target Kick + Elbow Target Strike

tips.text: Balnaldeung Pyojeokchigi is a technique that uses the back of the foot blade
Both hands should be placed naturally inside the body to easily assist the kick
Both feet slightly touch each other and stand with the knees facing forward
The knees should not be apart
Both hands and arms must move in unison
Start with the arm crossing in front of the chest
Both wrists should cross in front of the forehead
The wrists should be crossed diagonally
Slowly straighten the body and pull the fists next to the back on both sides
Put the back of the opposite foot blade on the inside of the kicking leg
Be careful not to perform the kick after the body has already twisted
